away.summary: The New York Rangers are coming off a 5-1 win against the Tampa Bay Lightning and have a young, energetic roster. They have added several new players to their lineup, including rookie Alberts Smits, and are looking to build on their recent success.

home.summary: The Detroit Red Wings are starting their season with a young and inexperienced roster, with several key players injured or out for the first few games. They are looking to build on the experience of their rookie forward Emmitt Finnie, who made his NHL debut last season.
